visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in cherry blossom avenue, school gate, riverside path; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with cherry blossom pink, fresh green, sky blue, cream; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by petal-level close-up, wide blossom avenue, backlit portrait; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
